sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 2 of 1987
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 2 of 1987
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY (ADMINISTRATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1987
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 11th June,. 1987]
No.F.17(2)/87-Pub., dated
11-6-1987.--The following order made by the President is hereby published for
general information:--
In exercise of the powers
conferred by Article 258 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the following Order:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the
Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) (Amendment) Order, 1987.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 2, P.O.No.18 of 1980.-- In the Islamabad
Capital Territory (Administration) Order, 1980 (P.O. 18 of 1980), in Article 2,
for the full-stop at the end a colon shall be substituted
and thereafter the following
proviso shall be added, namely:-
"Provided
that the President may, at any time, by order in writing.--
(a) direct that
the executive authority of the Federation in respect of Islamabad Capital
Territory in so far as it relates to any matter specified in the order shall,
subject to such conditions and limitations as may be specified therein, be
exercised by such authority established by or under any law as may be so
specified; and
(b) transfer the services of any person or class of persons
employed in the Islamabad Capital Territory in connection with the matters
aforesaid to the authority specified in the order under paragraph (a) "
